title.value: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study
title.justification: The paper evaluates a decision aid specifically developed for prenatal screening decisions.
title.quote: Background: We developed a decision aid (DA) to help pregnant women and their partners make informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy.

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development and evaluation of a decision aid aimed at assisting pregnant women and their partners in making informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy. It involves a mixed-methods study conducted in Quebec City to determine the usefulness and acceptability of the decision aid among the participants.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on medical decision-making aids in prenatal care, which is not related to eco-responsible AI.
primary_category.quote: Background: We developed a decision aid (DA) to help pregnant women and their partners make informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy.

secondary_categories.justification: No secondary eco-responsible category fits the content and purpose of this paper as it does not deal with environmental matters.
secondary_categories.quote: Most participants found the amount of information in the DA just right (79.5%), balanced (89.7%), and very useful (61.5%).

primary_sub_category.justification: The focus of the study is on prenatal care decision-making aids, which does not pertain to any environmental or eco-responsible sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: The next version of the DA will integrate the suggestions of end-users for better decision-making processes about prenatal screening for trisomy.
